svg.title: Continuity along ultrafilters. The passage to sequential convergence in the last paragraph of the derivation uses the following elementary fact, recorded because the order of choices depends on it: a bounded real sequence which tends to zero along every nonprincipal ultrafilter tends to zero, for if |xn| ≥ε on an infinite set, an ultrafilter containing that set contradicts the hypothesis. The finite seed stores and discrete tags are selected on one member of the ultrafilter after fixing the tree-gauge input Y ; no claim is made that a continuously varying configuration has a globally constant sector. The lifted statement is the same statement for aZ p = ap, with the same integrable majorant.
